gpt_6_astra_high/001: The policy uses fast bitboard move generation, territory and mobility evaluation, and time-bounded iterative alpha-beta search with selective move ordering. When the players occupy disconnected regions, it switches to a survival search that tries to maximize the number of remaining moves. A legal fallback is saved before search begins.
gpt_6_astra_high/002: The policy combines territory control, queen mobility, and distance-based influence with time-bounded alpha-beta search. It preserves diverse candidate moves, searches small endgames more thoroughly, and switches to a survival-maximizing solver when the players occupy disconnected regions.
gpt_6_astra_high/003: The policy combines territory evaluation with time-limited, iterative-deepening alpha-beta search. It evaluates both queen-distance and king-distance control, mobility, and inaccessible territory. Small endgames receive wider search; completely separated positions use a dedicated survival search. A legal move is saved before searching, ensuring a valid fallback if time runs out.
gpt_6_astra_high/004: The policy combines territory control, queen mobility, and timed adversarial search. It uses selective move ordering to search promising continuations deeply, removes beam restrictions in small endgames, and attempts a maximum-survival plan when the players occupy disconnected regions. A legal fallback move is established before searching.
gpt_6_astra_high/005: The policy combines territory control, queen mobility, and local escape space with time-bounded, selectively expanded alpha-beta search. It uses precomputed bitboard movement tables for speed. When the players are permanently separated, it instead searches for the longest possible survival sequence. A legal fallback move is saved before any expensive search.
